metadata.name: Marine Sediment Porewater Chemistry from Azores Station M186_50-1GC
metadata.description: Vertical profile of marine sediment porewater chemistry from a single deep-sea core site in the Azores (38.74047°N, 28.58108°W, water depth 1227 m). The dataset contains 18 samples spanning 0.29 to 3.64 meters below the seafloor, measuring temperature (AT), nutrients (nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate), major ions (chloride, sulfate, bromide, sodium, magnesium), and trace elements (boron, manganese, calcium, iron, strontium, silicon, barium, lithium, potassium). Samples were collected during cruise M186_50-1 on December 15, 2022.
metadata.spatial: Point location at 38.74047°N, 28.58108°W; vertical sediment profile from 0.29 to 3.64 m depth
